parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a man phoning to inquire about joining a local performance society.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.

Hello, this is the Leyton Society. How can I help?

Oh, hello. I'm just phoning you because I'm interested in becoming a member of your society, and I was wondering if you could give me some more information.

Of course. What would you like to know?

Well, first of all, I'd like to know where you hold the club meetings, as I'm not very mobile anymore, and I'm looking for somewhere that's within walking distance of my house. Are you still down at the old boathouse?

No, we moved away from there a while ago. Meetings are now held at the clubhouse.

Oh, brilliant. That's only five minutes from me. Do you require members to have any skills or experience?

No, there is no experience required. We have plenty of female singers and actresses, but we don't have many men who can play the male roles. We are looking to resolve this and are especially interested in recruiting male actors and singers.

I've never sung professionally, but I'm very keen on it, and I've been told that I'm talented, so I think this would be a good fit. Do you organize coaches to transport members to practice at the theater?

Unfortunately, the club does not have sufficient funds to organize transportation, though this is something we are working towards. We are currently looking for members who can drive so that we can organize car sharing. Members who are able to shuttle people in their cars will obviously be compensated for their petrol usage.

I don't drive, but I'd be happy to contribute some money in order to use the shuttle services.

Yes, that is no problem. Are you aware of when the meetings take place?

No, I couldn't find the meeting times on your website.

We hold meetings from six to eight PM every Tuesday.

Ah, that's lucky. I go to a debating club every Wednesday, so I'm glad that it's on a different night so I can attend both. Do you operate year-round?

We used to close during December for the Christmas period, but we found that a lot of members wanted to continue their practices during this time. We operate for most of the year, but we do, however, close for August because the weather gets so hot that we are unable to practice comfortably. This may change when we have enough funds to operate the air conditioning.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.

Now listen and answer questions six to ten.

Okay. I also wanted to ask how much the membership fee is and what is included with it.

Our membership fee is inexpensive, and it includes many benefits that certainly make the costs worth it. For example, we hold an annual event where members can meet each other and converse about topics that they have in common. We find that this is very popular, as the dinner is truly superb and included with your membership fee.

Wow, that sounds great. And how much does membership cost?

We have a couple of membership rates depending on your age and situation. For employed members under the age of thirty, the fee is forty pounds, while it costs sixty pounds for members aged between thirty and sixty. Which of these categories do you fit into?

Oh, I don't fit into either of those. I'm sixty-five years old and retired, so I'm no longer employed.

That's no problem at all. You qualify for the lowest price membership fee of twenty-five pounds, which applies to those who are either unemployed or retired.

Wow, that's really affordable. I was thinking of bringing my grandson along to some of the practices. So what would the membership cost for him? He's fourteen.

I'm afraid that the club is for adults only. That is to say we don't allow members who are age sixteen and under. He is welcome to join in two years' time, though.

Ah, that's a shame. I guess I can wait and buy him a membership for his birthday present.

Yes. What a good idea.

I was hoping I could bring him with me so I have someone there to talk to. I'm worried that I won't have anything in common with the other members.

I'm sure you'll fit in just fine. All our members are very friendly and interested in culture and music. Most of the people involved are modern authors looking for new experiences to write about in their books. You could read some of their books so you have something to discuss with them.

That's a good suggestion. I'll definitely do that. I'm really looking forward to attending the annual dinner so I can meet new people and hopefully make some friends.

Absolutely. Everyone has a great night, and it's all for charity, as all of the money raised from this event is donated to the children's hospital so they can buy toys and clothes.

Wow, what a great cause. Well, I will definitely be popping in soon to arrange my membership. Thank you for all of your help.

No problem at all. Goodbye.

Bye.

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音明确说到开会地点现在改到了clubhouse（俱乐部会所），结合题干已给出的“house”即可填出club。
你可能会听到前面的“old boathouse”而错填boat，但紧接着录音就否定了这里，强调已经搬走了（moved away）。
Are you still down at the old boathouse? No, we moved away from there a while ago. Meetings are now held at the clubhouse.
录音里直接提到他们特别想招募男演员和歌手（especially interested in recruiting male actors and singers）。
你可能会听到前面的“female”而误填，但那是他们已经有很多的（plenty of），而不是他们想要招募的目标。

Do you require members to have any skills or experience? No, there is no experience required. We have plenty of female singers and actresses, but we don't have many men who can play the male roles. We are looking to resolve this and are especially interested in recruiting male actors and singers.
录音中明确提到目前正在寻找能开车（can drive）的成员来组织拼车。
你可能会听到后面的“car sharing”或“shuttle”而迷失方向，注意题目问的是能够做某个动作的人，缺的是动词drive。

Do you organize coaches to transport members to practice at the theater? Unfortunately, the club does not have sufficient funds to organize transportation, though this is something we are working towards. We are currently looking for members who can drive so that we can organize car sharing. Members who are able to shuttle people in their cars will obviously be compensated for their petrol usage.
录音中工作人员清楚地说明了开会时间是每周二（every Tuesday）的晚上六点到八点。
你可能会听到前面男士提到的“every Wednesday”，但那是他参加另一个辩论俱乐部的时间，属于干扰信息。

Are you aware of when the meetings take place? No, I couldn't find the meeting times on your website. We hold meetings from six to eight PM every Tuesday. Ah, that's lucky. I go to a debating club every Wednesday, so I'm glad that it's on a different night so I can attend both.
录音提到因为天气太热，他们目前会在八月（August）闭馆休息。
你可能会听到“December”或“Christmas”而填错，但录音明确说那是过去（used to）的做法，现在已经改了。

Do you operate year-round? We used to close during December for the Christmas period, but we found that a lot of members wanted to continue their practices during this time. We operate for most of the year, but we do, however, close for August because the weather gets so hot that we are unable to practice comfortably.
录音中明确指出，非常丰盛的晚餐（dinner）是直接包含在会员费里的（included with your membership fee）。
你可能会听到前面的“benefits”或“annual event”而抓错重点，注意紧跟在“included with”前面的核心名词是dinner。

I also wanted to ask how much the membership fee is and what is included with it. Our membership fee is inexpensive, and it includes many benefits that certainly make the costs worth it. For example, we hold an annual event where members can meet each other and converse about topics that they have in common. We find that this is very popular, as the dinner is truly superb and included with your membership fee.
工作人员明确说明退休或失业人员符合最低会费标准，即25英镑（twenty-five pounds）。
你可能会听到前面提到的40镑或60镑，但那些都是针对“在职（employed）”成员的费用。

I'm sixty-five years old and retired, so I'm no longer employed. That's no problem at all. You qualify for the lowest price membership fee of twenty-five pounds, which applies to those who are either unemployed or retired.
录音中明确提到俱乐部不接受16岁（sixteen）及以下的成员，这正好对应了最低入会年龄的要求。
你可能会听到男士孙子的年龄“fourteen（14岁）”或者后面说的“two years' time（两年后）”，要注意区分具体设定的年龄界限是16岁。

So what would the membership cost for him? He's fourteen. I'm afraid that the club is for adults only. That is to say, we don't allow members who are aged sixteen and under. He is welcome to join in two years' time, though.
录音原句直接提到大部分参与的人都是寻找写作素材的现代（modern）作家。
这道题属于原词重现，只要跟上“Most of the people involved are...”的结构，就能直接锁定紧跟在authors前面的修饰词modern。
All our members are very friendly and interested in culture and music. Most of the people involved are modern authors looking for new experiences to write about in their books.
录音明确提到此次活动筹集的资金将捐赠给儿童医院（children's hospital）用来买玩具和衣服。
你可能听到后面的“toys”或“clothes”，但题目问的是“children's”后面所属的机构，应当填hospital。
Everyone has a great night, and it's all for charity, as all of the money raised from this event is donated to the children's hospital so they can buy toys and clothes.
